name: @indexnetwork/agent
description: A host-run personal agent: one identity, scopeable to an intent, that can ask its party questions and negotiate over A2A via @indexnetwork/a2a.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
